summary: Bisaccia-born coal-breaker worker of Dunmore known as Sam Genett, brother of Carmela "Mollie" Gianetta; John's great-granduncle.
bio:
Savino Giannetta, known in America as Sam Genett or Genet, was born about 1897 at Bisaccia, Italy. He came over with his mother about 1909, and the family settled in Dunmore, Pennsylvania, where they lived through the 1910s and 1920s; by 1920 Sam was working at a coal breaker. His brothers and sisters included Carmela "Mollie", John's great-grandmother, Mariano Martin (1899–1941), Maria (born 1902), Antonio (1907–1998), Giuseppe (1912–1971), Rosa (born 1914) and Charles J. (1916–1975).

Sam married Mamie (Dominica Maria) Bocchicchio. Their daughter Angelica A. Genett married Irving J. Weibel at Dunmore on 19 April 1947. Sam died in 1964. He is John's great-granduncle.
